messages:
Renee (marketing): Heads-up 1: HQ asked about sudden drop in 'launch post' MQLs on the weekly board. Regs are steady but MQL conversion slipped ~30% for Mar 31 cohort. Screenshot: https://dash.redwood/shot/launch-031.json :eyes:
Tobias (growth): which funnel step? click->reg or reg->mql?
Renee (marketing): reg->mql. clicks & regs flat. MQLs fell from 220 -> 153 in the 7-day window.
Asha (analytics): quick SQL shows a cluster of leads between 03-31 02:05-02:45 UTC with null utm_medium and lower enrichment scores. Looks like enrichment lag.
Felix (ops): dashbot reported `enrichment-worker` retries around 02:10 UTC and a transient backlog. I opened INC-2024-2412.
dashbot: alert attribution fallback for window 2024-03-31T02:00-02:50Z.
Tobias (growth): likely attribution fallback -> some webinar leads lost cohort tag, so reg counts look fine but assigned differently.
Renee (marketing): please hold slides until we confirm. I'll mark KPI deck draft as "pending data verification".
Asha (analytics): approved reprocess kicked: job id reproc_20240331_0230. ETA 9m. will include crm_merge and recovered_utm columns and attach a 50-row sample.
Felix (ops): mitigation: increasing enrichment lambda timeout to 60s and adding alert `enrichment_retries > 3` in 5m. Scheduling postmortem with infra + analytics tomorrow.
Asha (analytics): reproc finished 12: results: pre=153 mql, post=218 mql. recovered_utm=56, crm_merge=2, filtered_bots_reinstated=7. CSV: https://jobs.internal/reproc_20240331_0230/export.csv
Tobias (growth): great. annotate the KPI slide: "Numbers updated after reprocessing to correct for transient enrichment timeout (see INC-2024-2412)."
Renee (marketing): adding note now and sending updated deck to execs. Also filing a short blurb for the team newsletter about why small infra hiccups can skew weeklies. Thanks all :pray:
